**Install (in a bench with ERPNext)**
```sh
bench get-app https://github.com/Tacten/biograph
bench --site <site> install-app healthcare
```

**Run tests** (as CI does)
```sh
bench --site test_site run-parallel-tests --app healthcare
# single module/doctype during dev
bench --site <site> run-tests --app healthcare --doctype "Patient Appointment"
```

**Lint / format** (pre-commit runs ruff, ruff-format, prettier, eslint, pip-audit, detect-secrets)
```sh
pip install pre-commit && pre-commit install
npm install
pre-commit run --all-files
```

**Semgrep (Frappe rules)**
```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/frappe/semgrep-rules.git .frappe-semgrep-rules
pip install semgrep
semgrep ci --config ./.frappe-semgrep-rules/rules --config r/python.lang.correctness
```

**Patient Portal**
```sh
yarn install          # root postinstall also installs patient_portal
yarn build            # root: cd patient_portal && yarn build
cd patient_portal && yarn dev   # vite dev server
```

**Migrations:** `bench --site <site> migrate` runs the patches in `healthcare/patches.txt`.

**Commit messages** must pass commitlint (Conventional Commits).
